purpose: Owner-requested Hearth & Card material theme for Theandril's DOM HUD and management windows.
importMethod: Byte-identical copies of three already-reviewed lossless WebP runtime files. No regeneration, raster editing, palette conversion, resizing, native-tool run, atlas packing or sibling-project write.

license.authorization: The owner-requested local Theandril UI integration reuses these three original same-world materials. Preserve the original project attribution and retained separate asset-license terms; this is not a blanket MIT license for game artwork.
license.artLicense: Separately reserved; see retained ASSET_LICENSE.md. No claim of hand-drawn or third-party game art.

atlas.memoryNote: 512² × 4 bytes for each material plus 128² × 4 bytes for the corner = 2.0625 MiB potential separate DOM decode. Not measured GPU memory or part of the map atlas budget.

assets.animation: Static frame-zero idle extraction only; the source's four-frame clip is not imported or played.

sourceEvidence.note: The sibling lightweight checkout retains reviewed optimized runtime WebPs and original approval/provenance JSON. Referenced original generation PNGs and native PNG evidence remain upstream archive paths, not newly imported or fabricated source files.

inspection.stage: Inspected the three existing runtime images at their original native dimensions and the retained Card Shop desktop/mobile/binder screenshots before copying.
observations: Wood: broad dark walnut/mahogany boards, brass pins and carved edge flourishes; a dark CSS wash keeps dense text readable.
Parchment: ochre-worn decorative edges and visible palette speckling; a quiet cream CSS writing wash is required. It is not perfectly seamless.
Corner: a single transparent L-shaped gold acanthus/gem ornament. Imported unchanged as a static decorative background, separate from live text.
inspection.theandrilGameplayReview: Main /root inspected the original Card Shop materials/reference and the actual Theandril desktop compact-army, town-land, full-orders and 390px/130%-text screenshots. Retained in docs/art/reviews/slice25/. The first narrow orders layout was rejected for a float-induced skinny text column; the corrected one-column layout was reviewed. See docs/art/reviews/slice25-hud-and-towns.md for scope and limits. Source approval alone does not constitute HUD/layout acceptance.

limitations: Theme CSS changes materials, palette, typography, borders and shadows only; parent-owned campaign-hud.css supplies layout.
No new game content, faction meanings, gameplay animation, renderer textures or canonical state.
Native pixel sources stay unchanged. CSS background fitting/washes are presentation, not newly processed raster art.
No font downloads; Georgia/Times headings and system sans body text.
